messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api (us-east) p99 latency spike detected > 10s, request queue growth > 2k, GPU pool us-east-g1 at 100% utilization. Autoscaler attempted scale but received provisioning errors. Paging on-call.
Maya: I'm on it, paging infra.
Sam: grabbing logs from provisioner and GPU pool. seeing 0 available nodes, pending creations stuck in PROVISIONING -> ERROR.
Jordan: autoscaler log excerpt:```[2025-05-17T21:00:12Z] autoscaler: scaleUp(8) -> provisioner API error: QuotaExceeded: Request limit for GPUs reached for project/region (403). Retrying backoff.```
Lee: customer-facing impact? which tenants are showing timeouts vs 429s?
DevAPI: metrics: acme-inc p50->200ms p95->3.2s p99->11.4s, BetaCorp p95->5.8s p99->9.6s. Error surface: many 504s and some 429s from our internal ingress when queue length > 1500.
Tilly: support queue lighting up, multiple SEVs from ACME and Beta. We already replied with temporary note.
Maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable degraded-model fallback for hosted-api route (move heavy tenants to smaller model variant) 2) enable per-tenant soft-throttles for top 10 tenants 3) attempt manual capacity reassign from staging pools 4) restart provisioner leader if necessary.
Sam: cloud quota is the blocker for autoscaler creating new GPUs, provider console shows quota exhausted. I've opened quota request but ETA unknown. Starting manual reassign from staging now.
Jordan: running command to flip fallback routing:```POST /admin/routing/fallback
body: {"route":"/v1/completions","target_profile":"small-gen","match_tenants":["acme-inc","beta-corp"]}```Doing canary for 5% of traffic first.
Sam: reassign in-progress: `move-pool --from staging-gpu-pool --to hosted-us-east-g1 --count=4` output: `reassign initiated, expected attach 6m`
Maya: enabling soft-throttle for acme-inc to 60% of usual requests:```/admin/tenants/acme-inc/throttle set 0.6 --reason "protect cluster"```
DevAPI: confirming behavior: after routing change 5% canary -> p99 for that shard is 2.8s. Will ramp to 30% in 3m if stable.
Tilly: posting customer status update: "We're experiencing degraded performance in us-east due to capacity constraints; working on mitigations, temporary rate limits may apply."
Jordan: provisioner still showing errors but leader appears healthy. Will attempt soft-restart of provisioner leader to clear stuck allocations.
Sam: manual capacity attach completed: 4 GPUs moved from staging -> hosted-us-east-g1, nodes registered. Cloud console still shows quota at limit but reassign allowed.
incident-bot: UPDATE: queue length down 35% in last 7m, p95 from 3.2s -> 1.1s, p99 from 11.4s -> 3.4s.
Lee: great. what's the residual risk? any remaining tenants at high latency?
DevAPI: ACME now at p95 1.3s p99 3.6s after throttle + fallback. BetaCorp similar. A handful of long tail requests >10s due to inflight large contexts.
Maya: restarted provisioner leader successfully. Autoscaler attempted scale and received one more QuotaExceeded, but because we attached known nodes, traffic stabilized. We'll keep quota ticket open with provider.
Sam: filed provider ticket #PRJ-8421 for GPU quota increase and followup with account team. Also created internal runbook task to improve early warning for quota depletion.
Tilly: support notified customers ACME/Beta that we've stabilized and will follow up when fully resolved.
Jordan: post-mitigation logs:```[2025-05-17T21:12:30Z] autoscaler: scaleDecision: no-op (pool healthy)
[2025-05-17T21:13:05Z] runtime: average GPU util 68% across hosted-us-east-g1```
Maya: Handoff: I'll monitor for 30 more minutes, then hand to Sam for overnight. Action items: (1) quota escalation with provider (PRJ-8421) (2) add quota early-warning metric (runbook) (3) evaluate pre-warming for large-campaign tenants. I'll file GH issues.
Lee: thanks everyone. please add postmortem once follow-ups created.
Sam: ack, will take overnight watch after Maya.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: SEV2. Timeline and logs archived to incident ticket IR-2025-178.
